channel.title: on Industrial Manufacturing Knowledge Base
channel.description: Open industrial manufacturing knowledge base: aluminum & magnesium die casting, CNC machining, injection molding, tooling, materials, automotive manufacturing and supplier selection. 50+ engineering articles and reference tables.

item.title: Aluminum Die Casting Alloys: A380, ADC12, A356 Compared
item.description: Compare A380, ADC12, A383, A360, A413 and A356 aluminum die casting alloys on composition, tensile strength, castability and typical applications.

item.title: Aluminum vs Magnesium vs Zinc for Die Cast Parts
item.description: Compare aluminum, magnesium and zinc die casting on density, strength, cost, castability, corrosion, plating and service temperature to choose the right metal.

item.title: Heat Treatment of Aluminum Castings: T5, T6 and T7
item.description: Why conventional HPDC aluminum castings are not heat treated, and how T5, T6 and T7 tempers work for low-porosity and vacuum die cast structural parts.

item.title: Magnesium Alloys AZ91D and AM60B: Properties and Use
item.description: AZ91D and AM60B magnesium die casting alloys compared on composition, tensile strength, ductility, corrosion and process safety for thin-wall structural parts.

item.title: Surface Treatment for Castings: Anodizing, Coating, Plating
item.description: Anodizing, conversion coating, powder coat, e-coat and plating for aluminum, magnesium and zinc die castings, with porosity, adhesion and RoHS constraints.

item.title: Zinc Die Casting Alloys: Zamak 3, 5 and ZA Grades
item.description: Zamak 2, 3, 5, 7 and ZA-8, 12, 27 zinc die casting alloys compared on strength, ductility, castability, melting point and service temperature limits.
